title: Finding a Room for the Repair Club
transcript:
Hi. I’m trying to book a room for the campus repair club. We usually meet on Tuesday evenings in the engineering building, but the room will be used for exams for the next three weeks. Is there another place we can use?
Let me check. The upstairs room in the library is free on Tuesdays. It has enough chairs for your group. Would that work?
I’m afraid we need somewhere with tables. We help people fix things like lamps and radios, so we can’t do much without somewhere to put the tools.
In that case, how about the room next to the student café? It has large tables, and the lights are much better than in the library. The only problem is that it is already booked on Tuesdays.
What about Wednesday? We’ve held the club on Wednesdays before. I’d have to tell the members about the change, but most should be able to come.
Wednesday is free from half past six. You can stay until nine. If you need to bring equipment in beforehand, I can unlock the room from six.
That would help. Do we need to pick up a key each week?
No, just show your booking email to the café manager when you arrive. I’ll send it once you give me the club’s contact details. Please check that the room is tidy before you go.
Of course. I’ll also ask two members to stay and help put the tables back.

questions.prompt: Why does the repair club need to find a different room?
options: Its regular room is being painted.
Its regular room is needed for exams.
The engineering building closes earlier now.
Too many people have joined the club.
questions.answer: Its regular room is needed for exams.
questions.explanation: 工程楼里平时使用的房间在接下来三周要用于考试。

questions.prompt: Why does the student turn down the room in the library?
options: It is already booked for Tuesdays.
It does not have enough chairs.
It does not have tables for the work.
questions.answer: It does not have tables for the work.
questions.explanation: 维修活动需要桌子放置工具，图书馆房间不满足这一要求。

questions.prompt: When does the room by the student café become available on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 房间周三六点半可正式使用，六点开门只是为了提前搬入设备。

questions.prompt: What should club members show the café manager on arrival?
options: A written note from the repair club.
questions.explanation: 到场后只需向咖啡馆经理出示预订邮件，不必每周领取钥匙。
